title: Data Visualization Report
summary: A two-page A4 report that turns real business data into an executive signal, directly labeled charts, decisions, and a validation plan.
visualInvariants: Keep exactly two standard A4 pages with page one for signal and analysis and page two for decision and validation.
Preserve the cobalt-to-sky-blue hierarchy; yellow is a sparse emphasis color only.
Use directly labeled charts, readable print sizes, and real supplied data; never fabricate figures or conceal a legend dependency.
referenceHtml:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="use-iframe" content="true">
  <meta name="html-box-height-mode" content="auto">
  <meta name="description" content="A two-page A4 Open Design data report template with an executive signal, directly labeled charts, insights, an evidence table, and a validation framework.">
  <title>Document Workflow Signals · Data Visualization Report</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      --paper: #ffffff;
      --paper-deep: #f3f7ff;
      --ink: #111a33;
      --ink-soft: #3e4a68;
      --muted: #687492;
      --faint: #9aa8c4;
      --line: #dce6f8;
      --line-soft: #eaf0fb;
      --brand: #0039f6;
      --brand-text: #0039f6;
      --highlight: #d9e8ff;
      --blue: #0039f6;
      --blue-2: #1561fd;
      --blue-soft: #3a89ff;
      --blue-mid: #6dacff;
      --blue-pale: #a6ccff;
      --blue-faint: #d9e8ff;
      --cyan: #56d7ff;
      --yellow: #ffd21f;
      --navy: #07185f;
      --white: #ffffff;
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    html { background: #e8edf6; }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 48px 22px;
      color: var(--ink);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 13% 10%, rgba(255,255,255,.9), transparent 25%),
        #e8edf6;
      font-family: "Albert Sans", Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.5;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }

    .report {
      display: grid;
      width: min(100%, 940px);
      margin: 0 auto;
      gap: 28px;
    }

    .page {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 210 / 297;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--paper);
      border: 1px solid rgba(0,57,246,.08);
      box-shadow: 0 34px 80px -42px rgba(7,24,95,.34);
    }

    .page::after {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 8;
      pointer-events: none;
      opacity: .025;
      content: "";
      background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 140 140' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.74' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='.42'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
      mix-blend-mode: multiply;
    }

    .inner { position: relative; z-index: 1; height: 100%; padding: 22px 54px 34px; }
    .page--one .inner { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding-bottom: 63px; }
    .page--one .inner > * { flex-shrink: 0; }

    .masthead {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 24px;
      padding-bottom: 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    }

    .brand-lockup { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-weight: 730; }
    .brand-lockup svg { width: 25px; height: 25px; flex: 0 0 25px; }

    .document-meta {
      display: flex;
      gap: 22px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 650;
      letter-spacing: .14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .hero {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.22fr) minmax(245px, .78fr);
      gap: 38px;
      align-items: end;
      padding: 42px 0 0;
    }

    .eyebrow {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      color: var(--brand-text);
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 760;
      letter-spacing: .17em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .eyebrow::before { width: 30px; height: 3px; background: var(--brand); content: ""; }

    h1 {
      max-width: 585px;
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 31px;
      font-weight: 850;
      line-height: 1;
      letter-spacing: -.045em;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    h1 em { font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; font-weight: 400; }
    h1 .period { color: var(--brand-text); }

    .lede {
      max-width: 535px;
      margin: 18px 0 0;
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.58;
    }

    .brief-meta {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      margin-top: 20px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    }
    .brief-item { min-width: 0; padding: 10px 11px 10px 0; }
    .brief-item + .brief-item { padding-left: 11px; border-left: 1px solid var(--line); }
    .brief-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; color: var(--brand-text); font-size: 8.5px; font-weight: 780; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .brief-copy { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10.5px; line-height: 1.35; }

    .signal-card {
      position: relative;
      align-self: start;
      min-height: 180px;
      margin-top: 27.5px;
      padding: 18px 21px;
      overflow: hidden;
      color: var(--white);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 88% 18%, rgba(166,204,255,.28) 0, rgba(109,172,255,.16) 24%, transparent 48%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 68% 108%, rgba(86,215,255,.20) 0, rgba(58,137,255,.10) 30%, transparent 52%),
        var(--blue);
      border-radius: 22px;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -25px rgba(0,57,246,.72);
    }

    .signal-card::before {
      position: absolute;
      top: 18px;
      right: 18px;
      width: 42px;
      height: 42px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.15);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.24);
      border-radius: 13px;
      content: "";
    }

    .signal-card::after {
      position: absolute;
      right: -135px;
      bottom: -175px;
      width: 210px;
      height: 210px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.38);
      border-radius: 50%;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 28px rgba(86,215,255,.20), 0 0 0 56px rgba(217,232,255,.10);
      content: "";
    }

    .signal-icon { position: absolute; z-index: 2; top: 25px; right: 25px; width: 28px; height: 28px; }
    .signal-label { color: rgba(255,255,255,.7); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .signal-value { position: relative; z-index: 1; margin: 15px 0 12px; color: var(--white); font-size: 64px; font-weight: 850; line-height: .82; letter-spacing: -.065em; }
    .signal-title { position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 220px; font-size: 16.5px; font-weight: 720; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -.025em; }

    .kpi-strip {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 1fr 1fr 1.35fr;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 40px;
    }

    .kpi {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 126px;
      padding: 14px 14px 13px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--paper-deep);
      border: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
      border-radius: 14px;
    }
    .kpi-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .kpi-icon { display: grid; width: 28px; height: 28px; flex: 0 0 28px; place-items: center; color: var(--blue); background: var(--blue-faint); border-radius: 9px; }
    .kpi-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
    .kpi-label { color: var(--muted); font-size: 8px; font-weight: 740; letter-spacing: .13em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .kpi-value { margin: 11px 0 2px; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 840; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.045em; }
    .kpi-note { max-width: 150px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.4; }
    .micro-bars { position: absolute; right: 13px; bottom: 14px; display: flex; height: 30px; align-items: end; gap: 3px; }
    .micro-bars i { width: 4px; background: var(--blue-pale); border-radius: 4px 4px 1px 1px; }
    .micro-bars i:nth-child(2n) { background: var(--blue-mid); }
    .micro-bars i:nth-child(3n) { background: var(--blue); }
    .micro-users { position: absolute; right: 13px; bottom: 14px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 7px); gap: 4px; }
    .micro-users i { width: 7px; height: 7px; background: var(--blue-mid); border-radius: 50%; }
    .micro-users i:nth-child(-n+3) { background: var(--blue); }
    .micro-users i:last-child { background: var(--yellow); }
    .kpi--statement { color: var(--ink); background: #e8f1ff; border-color: #cfe0ff; }
    .kpi--statement::after { position: absolute; right: -22px; bottom: -36px; width: 88px; height: 88px; border: 14px solid rgba(0,57,246,.09); border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(4px); opacity: .72; content: ""; }
    .kpi--statement .kpi-label { color: var(--brand-text); }
    .kpi--statement .kpi-icon { color: var(--navy); background: var(--yellow); }
    .kpi--statement .kpi-value { position: relative; z-index: 1; margin-top: 11px; max-width: 185px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.28; letter-spacing: -.015em; }
    .kpi--statement .accent-rule { width: 28px; height: 4px; margin-top: 12px; background: var(--blue); border-radius: 4px; }

    .analysis-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.4fr) minmax(260px, .6fr);
      flex-grow: 1;
      gap: 22px;
      margin-top: 40px;
    }

    .panel {
      padding: 22px 23px 21px;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 18px;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 35px -30px rgba(0,57,246,.42);
    }

    .section-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
    .section-title { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 760; letter-spacing: -.025em; }
    .section-note { color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .04em; }

    .bar-list { display: grid; gap: 13px; }
    .bar-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 104px minmax(0,1fr) 34px; gap: 11px; align-items: center; }
    .bar-name { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 650; }
    .bar-track { position: relative; height: 13px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--paper-deep); border-radius: 99px; }
    .bar-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; }
    .bar-fill--1 { width: 100%; background: var(--blue); }
    .bar-fill--2 { width: 66.7%; background: var(--blue-2); }
    .bar-fill--3 { width: 38.3%; background: var(--blue-soft); }
    .bar-fill--4 { width: 23.5%; background: var(--blue-mid); }
    .bar-fill--5 { width: 4.9%; background: var(--blue-pale); }
    .bar-fill--6 { width: 2.5%; background: var(--blue-faint); }
    .bar-value { text-align: right; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 760; }

    .bar-axis { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 104px minmax(0,1fr) 34px; gap: 11px; margin-top: 9px; color: var(--faint); font-size: 8px; }
    .bar-axis-scale { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }
    .bar-summary { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 104px minmax(0,1fr) 34px; gap: 11px; align-items: center; margin-top: 15px; padding-top: 13px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line-soft); }
    .bar-summary-name { color: var(--brand-text); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 720; }
    .bar-summary .bar-track { height: 15px; background: var(--blue-faint); }
    .bar-summary .bar-fill { width: 71.7%; background: var(--blue); }
    .bar-summary .bar-value { color: var(--brand-text); font-size: 11px; }

    .share-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .donut-wrap { display: grid; place-items: center; margin: 0 auto 16px; }
    .donut {
      position: relative;
      display: grid;
      width: 146px;
      height: 146px;
      place-items: center;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: conic-gradient(var(--blue) 0 71.7%, var(--blue-mid) 71.7% 97.9%, var(--yellow) 97.9% 100%);
    }
    .donut::after { position: absolute; inset: 22px; background: var(--white); border-radius: 50%; content: ""; }
    .donut strong { position: relative; z-index: 1; font-size: 27px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.05em; }
    .donut span { position: absolute; z-index: 1; margin-top: 39px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }

    .legend { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin-top: auto; }
    .legend-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8px 1fr auto; gap: 8px; align-items: center; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; }
    .legend-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; }
    .legend-row b { color: var(--ink); font-size: 10px; }

    .comparison-panel {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(190px, .64fr) minmax(0, 1.36fr);
      flex-grow: 1;
      gap: 28px;
      margin-top: 40px;
      margin-bottom: 0;
      padding: 22px 24px 22px;
      background: var(--paper-deep);
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 18px;
    }
    .comparison-copy { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; }
    .comparison-copy .section-head { display: block; margin-bottom: 18px; }
    .comparison-copy .section-title { font-size: 18px; white-space: nowrap; }
    .comparison-copy .section-note { display: block; margin-top: 5px; }
    .comparison-copy p { margin: 9px 0 0; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; }
    .comparison-read { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin-top: 20px; }
    .comparison-read b { flex: 0 0 auto; color: var(--blue); font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.04em; white-space: nowrap; }
    .compare-chart { position: relative; min-height: 190px; margin: 2px 13px 16px 29px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.72); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--blue-pale); border-left: 1px solid var(--blue-pale); }
    .compare-chart::before { position: absolute; top: 50%; right: 0; left: 0; border-top: 1px dashed var(--line); content: ""; }
    .compare-chart::after { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 50%; border-left: 1px dashed var(--line); content: ""; }
    .axis-label { position: absolute; color: var(--faint); font-size: 7px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .axis-x { right: 0; bottom: -17px; }
    .axis-y { top: 0; left: -20px; writing-mode: vertical-rl; transform: rotate(180deg); }
    .quadrant-note { position: absolute; z-index: 1; color: var(--faint); font-size: 7px; letter-spacing: .05em; }
    .quadrant-note--a { top: 38%; right: 9px; }
    .quadrant-note--b { right: 9px; bottom: 8px; }
    .compare-point { position: absolute; z-index: 2; width: 12px; height: 12px; background: var(--blue); border: 2px solid var(--white); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,57,246,.16); }
    .compare-point span { position: absolute; top: -5px; right: 14px; width: max-content; padding: 3px 5px; color: var(--ink-soft); background: rgba(255,255,255,.96); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 5px 12px -10px rgba(7,24,95,.5); font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 760; line-height: 1.15; }
    .compare-point--2 { background: var(--blue-2); }
    .compare-point--3 { background: var(--blue-soft); }
    .compare-point--4 { background: var(--blue-mid); }
    .compare-legend { display: none; }

    .decision-slab {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.16fr) minmax(330px, .84fr);
      align-items: stretch;
      overflow: hidden;
      color: var(--white);
      background: var(--blue);
      border-radius: 20px;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 42px -28px rgba(0,57,246,.7);
    }

    .decision-main { padding: 18px 22px 17px; }
    .decision-kicker { color: var(--blue-faint); font-size: 8px; font-weight: 740; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .decision-main h2 { max-width: 490px; margin: 8px 0 6px; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -.035em; }
    .decision-main p { max-width: 500px; margin: 0; color: rgba(255,255,255,.76); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.55; }

    .decision-side { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22); }
    .decision-stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 16px 18px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.05); }
    .decision-stat:nth-child(2) { background: rgba(255,255,255,.09); }
    .decision-stat:nth-child(3) { background: rgba(255,255,255,.13); }
    .decision-stat + .decision-stat { border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2); }
    .decision-stat b { color: var(--white); font-size: 26px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.045em; }
    .decision-stat:last-child b { color: var(--yellow); }
    .decision-stat span { margin-top: 7px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.8); font-size: 10.5px; line-height: 1.35; }

    .insight-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 12px; margin-top: 10px; }
    .insight { min-height: 165px; padding: 18px; background: var(--paper-deep); border: 1px solid var(--line-soft); border-radius: 16px; }
    .insight-visual { display: grid; width: 40px; height: 40px; margin-bottom: 14px; place-items: center; color: var(--blue); background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -14px rgba(0,57,246,.58); }
    .insight-visual svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; overflow: visible; }
    .insight-index { color: var(--brand-text); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 780; letter-spacing: .13em; }
    .insight h3 { margin: 9px 0 7px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
    .insight p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.5; }

    .page-intro {
      display: block;
      padding: 18px 0 12px;
    }
    .page-intro h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 27px; line-height: 1.04; letter-spacing: -.04em; white-space: nowrap; }
    .page-intro p { max-width: 690px; margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; }

    .page--two .inner { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; padding-bottom: 63px; }
    .page--two .inner > * { flex-shrink: 0; }
    .page--two .section-title { font-size: 17px; }
    .page--two .section-number { margin-right: 8px; color: var(--brand-text); font-size: inherit; font-weight: inherit; letter-spacing: inherit; }
    .page--two .section-note { font-size: 10.5px; }
    .validation-section { padding-top: 26px; }
    .validation-section .section-head { margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .validation-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
    .validation-step { padding: 12px 14px 13px 0; }
    .validation-step + .validation-step { padding-left: 14px; border-left: 1px solid var(--line); }
    .validation-index { color: var(--brand-text); font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 780; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .validation-step h3 { margin: 6px 0 4px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.25; }
    .validation-step p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.45; }

    .data-section { padding-top: 26px; }
    .data-section .section-head { margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .data-table { width: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-spacing: 0; border-radius: 18px; border-collapse: separate; font-size: 11px; }
    .data-table th { padding: 8px 9px; color: var(--muted); background: var(--paper-deep); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-align: left; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .data-table td { padding: 6px 9px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft); }
    .data-table tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
    .data-table th, .data-table td { text-align: left; }
    .capability { font-weight: 690; }
    .family-pill { display: inline-block; min-width: 50px; padding: 2px 6px; color: var(--muted); background: var(--paper-deep); border-radius: 99px; font-size: 9px; text-align: center; }

    .completion-section { padding-top: 26px; }
    .completion-section .section-head { margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .completion-panel {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 178px 1fr;
      min-height: 158px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--paper-deep);
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 18px;
    }
    .completion-score {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 20px 22px;
      color: var(--white);
      background: var(--blue);
    }
    .completion-score span { color: var(--blue-faint); font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 760; letter-spacing: .15em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .completion-score strong { margin: 10px 0 7px; font-size: 42px; line-height: .9; letter-spacing: -.06em; }
    .completion-score p { margin: 0; color: rgba(255,255,255,.76); font-size: 10.5px; line-height: 1.45; }
    .completion-list { display: grid; grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr); }
    .completion-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 34px 1fr auto; gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding: 10px 16px; }
    .completion-item + .completion-item { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
    .completion-number { display: grid; width: 28px; height: 28px; color: var(--brand-text); background: var(--white); border-radius: 9px; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 780; place-items: center; }
    .completion-copy h3 { margin: 0 0 3px; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.2; }
    .completion-copy p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.38; }
    .completion-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 7px; color: #443600; background: var(--yellow); border-radius: 99px; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 780; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

    @media (max-width: 720px) {
      body { padding: 0; }
      .report { width: 100%; gap: 14px; }

      .page--one .kpi-strip, .page--one .analysis-grid, .page--one .comparison-panel { margin-top: 47px; }
      .page--one .inner, .page--two .inner { padding-bottom: 76px; }

<body>
  <main class="report">
    <section class="page page--one" aria-label="Data visualization report page 1 of 2">
      <div class="inner">
      <header class="masthead">
        <div class="brand-lockup">
          <svg viewBox="19 18.7266 82 82" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
            <path d="M101 59.7266C101 95.3019 95.5753 100.727 60 100.727C24.4247 100.727 19 95.3019 19 59.7266C19 24.1512 24.4247 18.7266 60 18.7266C95.5753 18.7266 101 24.1512 101 59.7266Z" fill="#202020"/>

          </svg>
          <span>Open Design</span>
        </div>
        <div class="document-meta"><span>Signal report / 01</span><span>60-day window</span><span>26 Aug 2026</span></div>
      </header>

      <section class="hero">
        <div>
          <div class="eyebrow">Document workflow intelligence</div>
          <h1>Format demand is already <em>visible</em><span class="period">.</span></h1>
          <p class="lede">A compact evidence brief showing which document capabilities reach the most people, which ones repeat, and where the next template investment should go.</p>
          <div class="brief-meta" aria-label="Analysis context and scope">
            <div class="brief-item"><span class="brief-label">Question</span><span class="brief-copy">Where should the next document template investment go?</span></div>
            <div class="brief-item"><span class="brief-label">Scope</span><span class="brief-copy">Six document capabilities · runs and distinct users · 60 days.</span></div>
            <div class="brief-item"><span class="brief-label">Read</span><span class="brief-copy">Volume shows demand; runs per user shows repeat intensity.</span></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="signal-card">
          <svg class="signal-icon" viewBox="0 0 28 28" aria-hidden="true">
            <rect x="3" y="14" width="4" height="9" rx="2" fill="white" opacity=".72"/>
            <rect x="10" y="9" width="4" height="14" rx="2" fill="white"/>
            <rect x="17" y="5" width="4" height="18" rx="2" fill="white" opacity=".86"/>
          </svg>
          <div class="signal-label">Executive signal</div>
          <div class="signal-value">72%</div>
          <div class="signal-title">of runs stay in editable document workflows.</div>
        </aside>
      </section>

      <section class="kpi-strip" aria-label="Headline metrics">
        <article class="kpi">
          <div class="kpi-head"><div class="kpi-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none"><path d="M2 13.5h12M3.5 11V7.5M8 11V3M12.5 11V5.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></div><div class="kpi-label">Observed runs</div></div>
          <div class="kpi-value">191</div><div class="kpi-note">Six capabilities · 60 days.</div>
          <div class="micro-bars" aria-hidden="true"><i style="height:9px"></i><i style="height:18px"></i><i style="height:13px"></i><i style="height:27px"></i><i style="height:20px"></i><i style="height:30px"></i></div>
        </article>
        <article class="kpi">
          <div class="kpi-head"><div class="kpi-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none"><path d="m3 11 3-3 2.2 2.2L13 5.4M10 5h3v3" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></div><div class="kpi-label">Highest volume</div></div>
          <div class="kpi-value">81</div><div class="kpi-note">General DOCX runs.</div>
          <div class="micro-bars" aria-hidden="true"><i style="height:7px"></i><i style="height:12px"></i><i style="height:17px"></i><i style="height:21px"></i><i style="height:26px"></i><i style="height:30px"></i></div>
        </article>
        <article class="kpi">
          <div class="kpi-head"><div class="kpi-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none"><circle cx="6" cy="5" r="2.3" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="M2.5 13c.3-2.3 1.5-3.5 3.5-3.5S9.2 10.7 9.5 13M10.3 4.1c1.7.1 2.7 1 2.7 2.4s-.9 2.2-2.4 2.4M11 10c1.5.3 2.3 1.3 2.5 3" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></div><div class="kpi-label">Widest reach</div></div>
          <div class="kpi-value">8</div><div class="kpi-note">Distinct PDF users.</div>
          <div class="micro-users" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>
        </article>
        <article class="kpi kpi--statement">
          <div class="kpi-head"><div class="kpi-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none"><path d="M8 2.2 9.5 6l4 .4-3 2.7.9 4-3.4-2-3.4 2 .9-4-3-2.7L6.5 6 8 2.2Z" fill="currentColor"/></svg></div><div class="kpi-label">Read this first</div></div>
          <div class="kpi-value">PDF attracts broader trial. DOCX earns deeper repetition.</div><div class="accent-rule"></div>
        </article>
      </section>

      <section class="analysis-grid">
        <article class="panel">
          <div class="section-head"><h2 class="section-title">Run volume by capability</h2><span class="section-note">Direct labels · no hidden legend</span></div>
          <div class="bar-list" role="img" aria-label="Horizontal bars showing DOCX 81 runs, Professional DOCX 54, PDF 31, Branded PDF 19, Writing Review 4, and Document 2">
            <div class="bar-row"><span class="bar-name">DOCX</span><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill bar-fill--1"></div></div><b class="bar-value">81</b></div>
            <div class="bar-row"><span class="bar-name">Professional DOCX</span><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill bar-fill--2"></div></div><b class="bar-value">54</b></div>
            <div class="bar-row"><span class="bar-name">PDF</span><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill bar-fill--3"></div></div><b class="bar-value">31</b></div>
            <div class="bar-row"><span class="bar-name">Branded PDF</span><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill bar-fill--4"></div></div><b class="bar-value">19</b></div>
            <div class="bar-row"><span class="bar-name">Writing Review</span><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill bar-fill--5"></div></div><b class="bar-value">4</b></div>
            <div class="bar-row"><span class="bar-name">Document</span><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill bar-fill--6"></div></div><b class="bar-value">2</b></div>
          </div>
          <div class="bar-axis"><span></span><div class="bar-axis-scale"><span>0</span><span>20</span><span>40</span><span>60</span><span>80</span></div><span></span></div>
          <div class="bar-summary" role="img" aria-label="Summary bar showing editable-document workflows account for 72 percent of observed runs">
            <span class="bar-summary-name">Editable share</span>
            <div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill"></div></div>
            <b class="bar-value">72%</b>
          </div>
        </article>

        <article class="panel share-panel">
          <div class="section-head"><h2 class="section-title">Activity mix</h2><span class="section-note">191 runs</span></div>
          <div class="donut-wrap"><div class="donut"><strong>72%</strong><span>Editable</span></div></div>
          <div class="legend">
            <div class="legend-row"><span class="legend-dot" style="background:var(--blue)"></span><span>DOCX family</span><b>137</b></div>
            <div class="legend-row"><span class="legend-dot" style="background:var(--blue-soft)"></span><span>PDF family</span><b>50</b></div>
            <div class="legend-row"><span class="legend-dot" style="background:var(--yellow)"></span><span>Writing review</span><b>4</b></div>
          </div>
        </article>
      </section>

      <section class="comparison-panel" aria-label="Reach and repetition comparison">
        <div class="comparison-copy">
          <div>
            <div class="section-head"><h2 class="section-title">Reach × repetition</h2><span class="section-note">Comparison module</span></div>
            <p>Volume alone hides the shape of demand. This view separates workflows that attract more people from those that create repeated use.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="comparison-read"><b>2 modes</b></div>
        </div>
        <div class="compare-chart" role="img" aria-label="Quadrant chart comparing users and runs per user for DOCX and PDF workflows">
          <span class="axis-label axis-y">Runs / user</span><span class="axis-label axis-x">Distinct users →</span>
          <span class="quadrant-note quadrant-note--a">Broad + repeated</span><span class="quadrant-note quadrant-note--b">Broad trial</span>
          <div class="compare-point" style="left:84%;bottom:79%"><span>DOCX · 7 / 11.6×</span></div>

          <div class="compare-point compare-point--4" style="left:60%;bottom:23%"><span style="top:-15px">Branded PDF · 5 / 3.8×</span></div>
        </div>
        <div class="compare-legend" aria-hidden="true">
          <div class="compare-legend-row"><i></i><span>DOCX<br>7 users · 11.6×</span></div>
          <div class="compare-legend-row"><i></i><span>Professional DOCX<br>4 users · 13.5×</span></div>
          <div class="compare-legend-row"><i></i><span>PDF<br>8 users · 3.9×</span></div>
          <div class="compare-legend-row"><i></i><span>Branded PDF<br>5 users · 3.8×</span></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="page page--two" aria-label="Data visualization report page 2 of 2">
      <div class="inner">
        <header class="masthead">
          <div class="brand-lockup">
            <svg viewBox="19 18.7266 82 82" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
              <path d="M101 59.7266C101 95.3019 95.5753 100.727 60 100.727C24.4247 100.727 19 95.3019 19 59.7266C19 24.1512 24.4247 18.7266 60 18.7266C95.5753 18.7266 101 24.1512 101 59.7266Z" fill="#202020"/>
              <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M59.8885 34.4258C73.8627 34.4258 85.191 45.7541 85.191 59.7283C85.191 73.7025 73.8627 85.0309 59.8885 85.0309H37.9523C36.0891 85.0309 34.5861 83.528 34.586 81.6648C34.586 76.0216 34.5859 64.7754 34.5859 59.7283C34.5859 45.7541 45.9143 34.4258 59.8885 34.4258ZM59.8886 39.4864C48.7092 39.4864 39.6465 48.5491 39.6465 59.7284C39.6465 70.9078 48.7092 79.9704 59.8886 79.9704C71.0679 79.9704 80.1305 70.9078 80.1306 59.7284C80.1306 48.5491 71.0679 39.4864 59.8886 39.4864Z" fill="white"/>
              <path d="M58.3164 71.6047L50.602 51.3039C50.3524 50.6469 50.994 50.0028 51.6467 50.2553L71.957 58.113C72.7928 58.4364 72.5625 59.6841 71.667 59.6841H59.8788V71.3146C59.8788 72.2163 58.6364 72.447 58.3164 71.6047Z" fill="white"/>
            </svg>
            <span>Open Design</span>
          </div>
          <div class="document-meta"><span>Signal report / 02</span><span>Decision & evidence</span><span>26 Aug 2026</span></div>
        </header>

        <section class="page-intro">
          <div>
            <h2>Turn the signal into a repeatable report.</h2>
          </div>
          <p>The pattern supports a focused next move: preserve PDF as the discovery surface, deepen editable-document workflows, and validate the new report template against the same 60-day baseline.</p>
        </section>

      <section class="decision-slab">
        <div class="decision-main">
          <div class="decision-kicker">Recommended move</div>
          <h2>Build a guided data-report workflow.</h2>
          <p>Prioritize a template that turns raw inputs into annotated charts, a decision-ready finding, and a shareable export.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="decision-side">
          <div class="decision-stat"><b>Now</b><span>recommended priority</span></div>
          <div class="decision-stat"><b>3</b><span>input · explain · export</span></div>
          <div class="decision-stat"><b>60d</b><span>baseline for validation</span></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="insight-grid" aria-label="Key findings">
        <article class="insight"><div class="insight-visual"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><circle cx="8" cy="9" r="3.2" fill="#6DACFF"/><circle cx="15.5" cy="8" r="2.5" fill="#0039F6"/><path d="M3.5 19c.5-4.1 2-6 4.8-6s4.4 1.9 4.8 6M13 13c3.4 0 5.1 1.8 5.5 5.3" stroke="#0039F6" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></div><div class="insight-index">Reach</div><h3>Fixed-format work opens the door.</h3><p>PDF has the broadest user coverage, making it the strongest discovery surface for practical document tasks.</p></article>
        <article class="insight"><div class="insight-visual"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M4 18h16" stroke="#A6CCFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><rect x="5" y="11" width="3" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#6DACFF"/><rect x="10.5" y="7" width="3" height="11" rx="1.5" fill="#1561FD"/><rect x="16" y="3" width="3" height="15" rx="1.5" fill="#0039F6"/></svg></div><div class="insight-index">Repetition</div><h3>Editable work brings users back.</h3><p>General and professional DOCX account for most observed runs and the highest repeat intensity.</p></article>
        <article class="insight"><div class="insight-visual"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M4 6.5h9M4 11h6M4 15.5h8" stroke="#6DACFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="m13 17 2.5-5 1.3 2.2 3.2-6" stroke="#0039F6" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></div><div class="insight-index">Next test</div><h3>Make evidence a first-class output.</h3><p>A data report template connects raw inputs, visual explanation, decisions, and a shareable document.</p></article>
      </section>

      <section class="validation-section" aria-label="Three-step validation plan">
        <div class="section-head"><h2 class="section-title"><span class="section-number">01</span>Validation plan</h2><span class="section-note">One guided workflow · three required outputs</span></div>
        <div class="validation-grid">
          <article class="validation-step"><div class="validation-index">Input</div><h3>Start with a bounded question.</h3><p>Capture the source data, analysis window, decision owner, and the question the report must resolve.</p></article>
          <article class="validation-step"><div class="validation-index">Explain</div><h3>Annotate the evidence.</h3><p>Pair each chart with a direct reading, a limitation, and the decision it supports.</p></article>
          <article class="validation-step"><div class="validation-index">Export</div><h3>Ship editable and fixed views.</h3><p>Validate the DOCX workflow for iteration and the PDF view for broader review and sharing.</p></article>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="data-section">
        <div class="section-head"><h2 class="section-title"><span class="section-number">02</span>Evidence detail</h2><span class="section-note">Top four of six capabilities · sorted by 60-day run volume</span></div>

          <thead><tr><th>Capability</th><th>Family</th><th>Runs</th><th>Users</th><th>Runs / user</th></tr></thead>

            <tr><td class="capability">minimax-pdf</td><td><span class="family-pill">PDF</span></td><td>19</td><td>5</td><td>3.8</td></tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </section>

      <section class="completion-section" aria-label="Definition of done">
        <div class="section-head"><h2 class="section-title"><span class="section-number">03</span>Definition of done</h2><span class="section-note">Release only when the report passes every gate</span></div>
        <div class="completion-panel">
          <div class="completion-score">
            <span>Release gate</span>
            <strong>3/3</strong>
            <p>One dataset, two formats, and three checks before the template is ready to ship.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="completion-list">
            <article class="completion-item">
              <div class="completion-number">01</div>
              <div class="completion-copy"><h3>Evidence is readable.</h3><p>Every chart carries a direct finding, its decision implication, and the relevant limitation.</p></div>
              <span class="completion-status">Required</span>
            </article>
            <article class="completion-item">
              <div class="completion-number">02</div>
              <div class="completion-copy"><h3>The document stays editable.</h3><p>DOCX preserves hierarchy, labels, and annotations when a reviewer changes the source content.</p></div>
              <span class="completion-status">Required</span>
            </article>
            <article class="completion-item">
              <div class="completion-number">03</div>
              <div class="completion-copy"><h3>The fixed view stays intact.</h3><p>PDF exports as two complete A4 pages with no clipped charts, tables, notes, or page furniture.</p></div>
              <span class="completion-status">Required</span>
            </article>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      </div>
    </section>
  </main>
</body>
